snippet.title: Ratchet & Clank: Ranger Rumble | Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
🚨 Welcome Rangers! Are you ready to Rumble?! 💥

Step into Captain Qwark’s totally safe simulation and experience Ratchet & Clank: Ranger Rumble, a fast-paced multiplayer platformer arena shooter on mobile!

Play as legendary heroes from across the galaxy and time, customize your Ranger, and unleash your skill in chaotic game modes!

Jump, dash, grind, collect bolts, and become the next Galactic Ranger, and don’t forget to smile… Captain Qwark is watching you! 👀

🎟️ Pre-register now: https://bit.ly/RangerRumble_Pre_Reg

🔔 Subscribe to stay updated: https://www.youtube.com/@RangerRumble

📌 Follow for updates:

Facebook : https://www.facebook.com/RangerRumble/
X : https://x.com/RCRangerRumble/
Instagram : https://www.instagram.com/rangerrumble/
Tik-Tok : https://www.tiktok.com/@rangerrumble

#RCRangerRumble
